blocks.orig: Nestled high above the plains into the crater’s jagged rim, cloaked in river stone and indigenous vines, the Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge offers the most splendid views over the ancient Ngorongoro crater while barely being visible with the naked eye. The 75 rustic rooms are looped around the crater rim, boasting a lush almost old-fashioned decor with rock-enclosed balconies right on the crater’s edge, ensuite bathrooms and good beds, all donned in brown and ecru colours. The elegant yet relaxed dining space features a glowing fireplace, walls with prehistoric cave paintings, and – how can it not be – the same magical views next to good, hearty food. This special and luxurious lodge feels almost as ancient as the crater itself, yet free WiFi, digital TV and a spa are available to cater to your every need.
blocks.html: Built high above the plains into the jagged rim of the crater and covered in river stone and native vines, the Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge is hardly visible to the naked eye, yet it enjoys superb views across the ancient Ngorongoro crater. Its 75 rustic rooms follow the curve of the crater rim, with a rich, slightly old-fashioned decor, balconies enclosed by rock right on the crater’s edge, ensuite bathrooms and good beds, all in shades of brown and ecru. The dining area is elegant yet relaxed, with a warm fireplace, walls showing prehistoric cave paintings and – naturally – the same magical views alongside good, hearty meals. This special, luxurious lodge seems nearly as old as the crater itself, but free WiFi, digital TV and a spa are on hand for all your needs.
